title: Negative demonstrative statements review
focus: Mix singular negatives, plural negatives, and controlled affirmative-to-negative transformations.

exercises.prompt: Choose the sentence that means “The book is not here.” Use se kirja (“the book”) and täällä (“here”).
exercises.explanation: Se kirja is singular and therefore takes ei ole.

sentenceExplanation.pattern: demonstrative noun phrase subject + negative verb carrying number agreement + main verb after the negative verb + location

parts.formation: the complete singular subject is supplied
third-person singular form

parts.role: main verb after the negative verb
parts.formation: fixed form after the negative verb
unchanged location word

Correct. Se kirja is singular and therefore takes ei ole.
“eivät” is the plural negative verb; use “ei”, the singular negative verb.
“on” is the singular affirmative form of olla; use “ei”, the singular negative verb.
“on” is the singular affirmative form of olla; use “ole”, the main verb form required after the negative verb.
